verdict.rationale: Extend is a document-processing platform, not an agent itself, so publishing an MCP server is an applicable axis. A first-party docs page titled 'Using Extend via MCP' exists, and a probe confirms an official MCP server is documented at docs.extend.ai/mcp, so the core of the story is delivered. However, the evidence shows only the page's existence, not its contents. Missing for 10: details on exposed tools, transport and auth setup, and supported agent clients, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.
